title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 13: a prophet or dreamer who leads to other gods, secret enticers and a city drawn away to serve other gods.

questions.text: Besides a prophet, who else is named in Deuteronomy 13:1 as someone who might give a sign or a wonder?
questions.explanation: The chapter speaks of a prophet or a dreamer of dreams who arises and gives a sign or a wonder.

answers.text: A king of the nations
A priest of Egypt
A dreamer of dreams
A singer at the gate

questions.text: Why should they not listen to a prophet whose sign comes true but who says, "Let's go after other gods"?
questions.explanation: Yahweh their God is testing them, to know whether they love him with all their heart and with all their soul.

answers.text: Yahweh is testing whether they love him
The prophet comes from a foreign land
The prophet is too young to speak for God
The sign was not great enough to believe

questions.text: What must happen to that prophet or dreamer of dreams?
questions.explanation: He shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh their God. So they remove the evil from among them.

answers.text: He shall be sent out of the land
He shall fast forty days
He shall bring a sin offering
He shall be put to death

questions.text: Which of these is named in Deuteronomy 13:6 as someone who might secretly entice them to serve other gods?
questions.explanation: The list includes a brother, a son, a daughter, the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul.

answers.text: A king of Israel
A friend who is as your own soul
A priest at the altar
A servant of your neighbor

questions.text: Whose hand must be first on the one who entices them?
questions.explanation: "Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people."

answers.text: The hand of the one enticed
The hand of the priest
The hand of the elders
The hand of the judge

questions.text: How is the enticer to be put to death?
questions.explanation: They shall stone him to death with stones, because he sought to draw them away from Yahweh.

answers.text: With the edge of the sword
He is burned with fire
He is stoned with stones
He is thrown from a cliff

questions.text: What result does Deuteronomy 13:11 give for this punishment?
questions.explanation: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among them.

answers.text: The enticer's family will leave the land
All Israel will hear, fear, and not do such wickedness again
The other nations will make peace with Israel
The rain will come in its season

questions.text: What must they do first when they hear that a city has been drawn away to serve other gods?
questions.explanation: They are to inquire, investigate and ask diligently whether it is true and the thing certain.

answers.text: Attack the city on the same day
Send gifts to the city's elders
Ask a dreamer of dreams
Inquire, investigate and ask diligently

questions.text: What shall become of such a city once it is burned?
questions.explanation: The city and all its plunder are burned with fire to Yahweh. It shall be a heap forever and shall not be built again.

answers.text: It shall be given to the Levites
It shall be rebuilt after seven years
It shall be a heap forever and never be built again
It shall become a city of refuge

questions.text: What must not cling to their hand, according to Deuteronomy 13:17?
questions.explanation: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to their hand, so that Yahweh may turn from his anger and show them mercy.

answers.text: Anything of the devoted thing
The blood of the slain
The ashes of the altar
The dust of the road
